description.value: Kitsilano Showboat is an open-air theatre venue in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood. It offers outdoor performances in a public-facing setting that cycling visitors passing through the area may find worthwhile. The venue's open-air format and proximity to the waterfront make it a natural stopping point on a coastal cycling route.
